channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Devin Harris | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Devin Harris from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Michael Malone on Devin Harris
item.description:
More Michael Malone on newly acquired #Nuggets backup PG Devin Harris:

“He brings a quickness and a pace that we haven’t really had in that position. He’s a blur. He can get to anywhere he wants on the court.”

Michael Malone on Devin Harris, Feb 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Devin Harris
item.description:
Mavs prez of basketball operations Donnie Nelson on Devin Harris:

“He's forever going to be a part of our family. In my opinion, I think he'll end his career here.”

Donnie Nelson on Devin Harris, Feb 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Devin Harris
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Rick Carlisle:

“@Devin Harris would be an excellent coach. He’s a terrific communicator, he’s an energetic guy, and he’s got a very good spacial view of the game as well. He has a good feel for the importance of the attention to detail.”

Rick Carlisle on Devin Harris, Feb 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Devin Harris
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Brandon Ingram on his ankle:

“My foot got twisted in his (Devin Harris) legs. I couldn’t really push off on it. I’ll see how it feels tomorrow.”

Brandon Ingram on Devin Harris, Jan 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Devin Harris
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Donnie Nelson on Devin Harris' team option:

“He started his career here, and we're hoping he'll end his career here.”

Donnie Nelson on Devin Harris, Jun 22, 2017. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Devin Harris, Raymond Felton, Deron Williams, JJ Barea
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle:

“We’re going 2 keep all our point guards. All those guys, Williams, Barea, Harris, Felton, those guys are going 2 be on the team.”

Rick Carlisle on Devin Harris, Raymond Felton, Deron Williams, JJ Barea, Oct 10, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Devin Harris, Dwight Howard
item.description:
“We're scrambling like hell defensively and Devin Harris is going to get the ball, and Dwight Howard throws him into our bench,”

Rick Carlisle on Devin Harris, Dwight Howard, Apr 27, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Devin Harris, Dwight Howard
item.description:
“We’re scrambling like hell defensively, and Devin Harris is going to get the ball, and Dwight Howard throws him into our bench. He takes the ball, skips it over the top and Ariza gets a wide-open three.“So, instead of us getting the ball, and a foul on Howard, it turns into essentially a 5-6 point swing. That stuff’s got to stop. The officials [have] got to get that stuff under control, because there’s too much physical stuff going on. Howard is throwing people all over the place. And that can’t happen in Game 4.”

Rick Carlisle on Devin Harris, Dwight Howard, Apr 25, 2015. Source: Houston Chronicle.
